1. Contradiction (blocking): closed.

   - `claude-5.5/root/identity.md:10` and `kimi-k3.1/root/identity.md:27` now give `git worktree add -b <name> <path> <start>`.

`packages/runtime/src/vcs/errors.ts:125`: the `DetachedHead` error hint says "Check out or create a branch with `git switch -c <name>`". It is a runtime hint, not instruction text, and it fires only when committing on a detached HEAD, which the rule already forbids in a cloud primary checkout.
